response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt::numeric) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt)::numeric AS total_cnt FROM matched) SELECT m.tradekind AS trader_type, m.cnt AS trader_count, m.cnt::numeric / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, m.cnt::numeric - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM matched m CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND m.cnt > s.avg_cnt
